## Enlivex Announces Pricing of $7.5 Million Registered Direct Offering Priced At-The-Market Under Nasdaq Rules


Nes-Ziona, Israel, Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Enlivex Ltd. (Nasdaq: ENLV, “Enlivex” or the “Company”), a quality longevity company powered by a prediction markets treasury, today announced that it has entered into a securities purchase agreement with certain investors for the purchase and sale, in a registered direct offering, of an aggregate of $7,500,000 of the Company’s ordinary shares (or pre-funded warrants in lieu thereof), together with accompanying ordinary warrants to purchase up to an equal number of ordinary shares, at a combined purchase price of $1.315 per ordinary share (or $1.314 per pre-funded warrant) and accompanying ordinary warrant, representing a premium of 10.5% to the Nasdaq official closing price of the ordinary shares on November 13, 2026 (the “Registered Offering”). The ordinary warrants will have an exercise price of $1.578 per share, will be exercisable immediately upon issuance, and will expire three years from the initial closing date. The pre-funded warrants will have an exercise price of $0.001 per share, will be exercisable immediately upon issuance, and will not expire until exercised in full.


The Registered Offering will be consummated in a series of closings. At the initial closing, which is expected to occur on or about November 17, 2026, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions, the investors will purchase an aggregate of $500,000 of securities. The investors have also irrevocably committed, subject only to the continued listing of the ordinary shares on Nasdaq or another U.S. national securities exchange, to purchase an additional aggregate of $700,000 of securities at each of ten subsequent monthly closings, commencing on December 1, 2026, and ending on or about September 1, 2027, for an aggregate of $7,000,000, at the same price and on the same terms as those applicable to the initial closing. Certain of the subsequent closings may be postponed until the Company’s receipt of shareholder approval of an increase in its authorized share capital, and any subsequent closing may be postponed if the Company’s registration statement or prospectus is not then available. The purchase price may be paid in U.S. dollars, USDT, or a combination thereof.


The aggregate gross proceeds to the Company from the Registered Offering are expected to be approximately $7.5 million, assuming all closings are consummated, before deducting offering expenses payable by the Company and excluding any proceeds from the exercise of the ordinary warrants. If the ordinary warrants issued in the Registered Offering are exercised in full for cash, the Company would receive additional gross proceeds of approximately $9.0 million; however, no assurance can be given that any of the ordinary warrants will be exercised. The Company intends to use the net proceeds from the Registered Offering for clinical, regulatory, manufacturing, and research and development activities; potential acquisitions and in-licensing; and other general corporate purposes. The Registered Offering is being made directly by the Company, without a placement agent, underwriter, broker or dealer, and no placement agent fees will be payable.


The ordinary shares, pre-funded warrants and ordinary warrants offered in the Registered Offering, and the ordinary shares issuable upon exercise of such warrants, are being offered by the Company pursuant to a shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-286956) previously filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”), which became effective on May 12, 2025. The Registered Offering is being made only by means of a prospectus supplement and accompanying base prospectus that form a part of the registration statement. A final prospectus supplement and accompanying base prospectus relating to the Registered Offering will be filed with the SEC and, when filed, will be available on the SEC’s website at[www.sec.gov](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=AEAMBnU5P2iu-JfuYOB3JM-Tgpo3_78Zg3CzhcJWgIAodG2IIbTuT9wx-OCLJk52XMtk3JpfbsoIb6u0chlRAg==) . Additional information regarding the securities described above and the terms of the transactions will be included in a Report on Form 6-K to be filed by the Company with the SEC.


In connection with the transactions, the Company has also agreed to pay to certain investors that meet a minimum subscription threshold, subject to the terms and conditions of the securities purchase agreement, (i) 5% of upfront, down, milestone and royalty payments received by the Company or its subsidiaries during the five years following execution, from license, collaboration, partnership, co-development, co-commercialization, distribution, supply and similar commercial transactions relating to its product candidates that are entered into during the period commencing upon the Company’s receipt of the full $7.5 million subscription amount and ending 24 months following the date of the securities purchase agreement, and (ii) 5% of the proceeds paid to the Company or its shareholders from any sale, exclusive license or other disposition of the Company’s clinical assets during such 24-month period, subject to any required shareholder approval. An investor’s right to receive such payments will be forfeited if it fails to fund at least $850,000 of that aggregate subscription amount under the securities purchase agreement.


Greenberg Traurig, P.A. and FISCHER (FBC & Co.) are serving as legal counsel to Enlivex.


This press release shall not constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy any of the securities described herein, nor shall there be any sale of these securities in any state or other jurisdiction in which such offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful prior to registration or qualification under the securities laws of any such state or other jurisdiction.


**ABOUT ENLIVEX**


Enlivex is a quality longevity company powered by a prediction markets treasury. The Company is advancing Allocetra™, an advanced clinical-stage immunotherapy targeting inflammatory conditions associated with aging, with a primary focus on age-related osteoarthritis. In addition to its clinical programs, Enlivex operates a prediction markets treasury strategy built around the Rain protocol, the leading decentralized prediction markets infrastructure on Arbitrum. This dual strategy combines the development of quality longevity therapeutics with exposure to the emerging prediction markets ecosystem.
